title: Context Menu
description: A menu that opens on right-click, with actions, checkbox and radio items, labelled groups and destructive entries.

components.ContextMenu: Groups all parts of the context menu, which opens on right-click.
components.ContextMenuCheckboxItem: Lets the user switch an option on or off from the menu.
components.ContextMenuContent: Holds the items the context menu shows while open.
components.ContextMenuGroup: Groups related items in the context menu.
components.ContextMenuItem: Holds one action the user can pick from the context menu.
components.ContextMenuLabel: Labels a group of items in the context menu.
components.ContextMenuPortal: Places the menu content above the rest of the page.
components.ContextMenuRadioGroup: Groups radio items so the user can pick exactly one.
components.ContextMenuRadioItem: Lets the user choose one option from a group in the menu.
components.ContextMenuSeparator: Separates groups of items in the context menu.
components.ContextMenuShortcut: Shows the keyboard shortcut for a menu item.
components.ContextMenuSub: Groups a submenu trigger with the submenu it opens.
components.ContextMenuSubContent: Holds the items of a submenu while it is open.
components.ContextMenuSubTrigger: Opens a submenu from an item of the context menu.
components.ContextMenuTrigger: Marks the area where a right-click opens the context menu.
